title: Fangirl
author: Rainbow Rowell
summary: Cath is a shy first-year at university who writes popular fan fiction about a boy wizard, while her twin sister Wren pulls away. She must cope with a new roommate, a difficult father and her first romance.
readIf: you love fandom, anxious heroines and gentle campus romance.
skipIf: you want high-stakes plot or little romance.
